items.title: Bitcoin just closed its 7th straight red week — the first such streak since the 2022 bear market.
items.summary: Bitcoin just closed its 7th straight red week — the first such streak since the 2022 bear market. It crashed to $55,130 on Saturday, its lowest since Sept 2024, before clawing back above $61,000. (CoinDesk)
body: Bitcoin just closed its 7th straight red week — the first such streak since the 2022 bear market. It crashed to $55,130 on Saturday, its lowest since Sept 2024, before clawing back above $61,000. (CoinDesk)
The weekly close landed at $61,144. Bitcoin is down ~30% since early October and more than 50% below its ~$126,200 peak. Spot ETFs bled $1.79B last week — a 4th straight week of outflows. (CoinDesk)

The crash was driven by stocks, not crypto: the Nasdaq just had its worst week since March 2020. Fear & Greed reads 9 — extreme fear. Resistance sits at $62K–$65K; below $55K, $53K is next. (CoinDesk)
items.source: CoinDesk ("Bitcoin rebounds from 2-year low as Wall Street futures recover", 23 Nov 2026), Unchained ("Bitcoin Regains $61,000 After Weekend Plunge", 23 Nov 2026), TradingView/BeInCrypto (7th straight red weekly candle, weekly close $61,144, first since 2022)

items.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine's Kyiv region killed at least 15 people overnight.
items.summary: Russian strikes on Ukraine's Kyiv region killed at least 15 people overnight. A drone hit a five-storey block in Dymer, north of Kyiv — 11 dead there. Rescuers are still searching the rubble. (Reuters, AFP)
body: Russian strikes on Ukraine's Kyiv region killed at least 15 people overnight. A drone hit a five-storey block in Dymer, north of Kyiv — 11 dead there. Rescuers are still searching the rubble. (Reuters, AFP)
Among the dead in Dymer: a teenager and a woman in her 40s. Rescuers pulled a child and a 79-year-old woman out alive. 11 people, including two children, are still unaccounted for. (AFP)
The Kremlin says a new round of Russia–Ukraine–US talks will be held soon — no date set. The last round in Abu Dhabi ended with a prisoner swap agreed in principle. (RIA Novosti)
items.source: Reuters ("Russian attack on Ukraine's Dymer in Kyiv region kills 11, official says", 23 Nov 2026), AFP (via europesays/Guardian briefing: 15 killed across Kyiv region; korban termasuk remaja dan wanita 40-an; 11 orang belum ditemukan termasuk 2 anak; anak dan wanita 79 tahun diselamatkan hidup-hidup). Klaim perundingan: atribusi Kremlin/RIA Novosti

items.title: NATO meets in emergency session TODAY after Poland confirmed all three objects that crashed on its soil Friday were Russian Kh-10…
items.summary: NATO meets in emergency session TODAY after Poland confirmed all three objects that crashed on its soil Friday were Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles. (Reuters)
body: NATO meets in emergency session TODAY after Poland confirmed all three objects that crashed on its soil Friday were Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles. (Reuters)
Polish prosecutors say debris analysis shows the missiles were made in late 2026 at a plant near Moscow. No one was hurt — but PM Tusk calls it 'an intentional provocation.' (Reuters, AP)
NATO chief Mark Rutte, in Warsaw on Saturday: 'NATO will defend every inch of Polish territory.' Poland will press allies for stronger air defences on its eastern border. (Reuters)
The North Atlantic Council — NATO's top decision-making body, all 32 members — convenes in Brussels today. Watch for what allies agree on air defence. (Reuters)
items.source: Reuters ("Three Russian missiles flew into Poland Friday, prosecutors say", 22 Nov 2026), AP (via Reuters/AP corroboration)

items.title: COP31 COLLAPSES: UN climate talks in Antalya end with no deal after ~40 hrs of overtime — the first failed COP since 2009.
items.summary: COP31 COLLAPSES: UN climate talks in Antalya end with no deal after ~40 hrs of overtime — the first failed COP since 2009. The deadlock: fossil fuels. 🧵 (Reuters, BBC)
body: COP31 COLLAPSES: UN climate talks in Antalya end with no deal after ~40 hrs of overtime — the first failed COP since 2009. The deadlock: fossil fuels. 🧵 (Reuters, BBC)
The final draft never mentioned fossil fuels. Saudi Arabia and Russia blocked the wording; the EU, Panama and island states refused to sign without it. ~130 nations demanded a phase-out. (Reuters)
UN chief Guterres said he is 'deeply disappointed.' EU climate chief Hoekstra had warned: 'It's either going to be a good deal or it's going to be no deal.' (Reuters, Al Jazeera)

Not all was lost: 90+ nations signed an electrification pledge, and the draft admitted the world is on track to pass 1.5°C. But after 30 years, the COP process itself is now in question. (BBC, Reuters)
items.source: Reuters (3 artikel, 22–23 Nov 2026), BBC, Al Jazeera, AFP

items.title: BREAKING: A Russian warship has been sunk in Libya — thousands of km from Ukraine.
items.summary: BREAKING: A Russian warship has been sunk in Libya — thousands of km from Ukraine. The corvette Merkury capsized at Benghazi naval base after a suspected drone strike early Sunday, satellite images show. (Reuters)
body: BREAKING: A Russian warship has been sunk in Libya — thousands of km from Ukraine. The corvette Merkury capsized at Benghazi naval base after a suspected drone strike early Sunday, satellite images show. (Reuters)
Libyan officials say sea drones launched from a Ukrainian-run base in western Libya hit the ship — at least 4 were intercepted, 2 struck home, per AP. Kyiv has not claimed responsibility.
The Merkury had stopped in Benghazi to refuel on its way back to Russia. 10 people were slightly injured; no deaths reported, per Reuters. A Maltese-flagged cargo ship was also hit off Benghazi.
It is the second Russian ship hit this weekend — after a cargo vessel was struck in the Baltic on Saturday. Ukraine's war at sea is now reaching far beyond the Black Sea. (WSJ)
items.source: Reuters, AP, CNN, The Times, WSJ

items.title: Bitcoin just staged a violent round trip: crashing to ~$55,100 — its lowest since Sept 2024 — then snapping back above $60,000 in…
items.summary: Bitcoin just staged a violent round trip: crashing to ~$55,100 — its lowest since Sept 2024 — then snapping back above $60,000 in hours. The whipsaw wiped out $2.7B in leveraged positions. (Reuters/CoinDesk)
body: Bitcoin just staged a violent round trip: crashing to ~$55,100 — its lowest since Sept 2024 — then snapping back above $60,000 in hours. The whipsaw wiped out $2.7B in leveraged positions. (Reuters/CoinDesk)

The trigger wasn't crypto: AI-stock fears hammered risk assets — Nasdaq fell over 4% Friday, Nvidia ~14%. Forced selling then fed on itself: ~$650M liquidated in a single hour at the worst point. (Reuters/CoinGlass)

Don't call it a recovery yet: the bounce was driven by short covering, and US spot ETFs bled ~$1.25B this week. Holding $60,000 into Monday is the test — lose it and the $55,000 low comes back into play. (Farside/CoinDesk)
items.source: Reuters (low ~$55,251–55,830; rebound >8% ke ~$59,952, sempat tembus $60,000), CoinDesk (BTC ~$60,300; forced selling mereda), CoinGlass via Kobeissi Letter ($2.7B likuidasi 24 jam, event likuidasi terbesar ke-11 sepanjang sejarah), Farside via TradingView (ETF outflow ~$1.25B minggu 16–20 Nov), Finnhub (BTC $60,713.56 per 22 Nov 13:28 UTC; close 21 Nov $60,215.77; low 21 Nov $55,130)

items.title: Mexico has captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores — 'El Chapo Isidro' — one of the FBI's 10 most wanted fugitives, after a deadly rai…
items.summary: Mexico has captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores — 'El Chapo Isidro' — one of the FBI's 10 most wanted fugitives, after a deadly raid in Sinaloa. 11 people were killed in the fighting. (CNN/AP)
body: Mexico has captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores — 'El Chapo Isidro' — one of the FBI's 10 most wanted fugitives, after a deadly raid in Sinaloa. 11 people were killed in the fighting. (CNN/AP)

Mexican special forces stormed a house in Guasave, Sinaloa, on Friday night. 7 suspected cartel gunmen and 4 soldiers were killed; 8 people were arrested, including his No. 2. Gunfire sent baseball fans fleeing a stadium. (AP)
Meza Flores led the Beltrán Leyva-linked Los Mazatlecos cartel and was wanted in the US on drug trafficking charges. Washington had offered a $5M reward; US intelligence helped the operation. (CNN)

items.title: Zelensky calls Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean Bridge a "fair response" — Russia hit Ukrainian bridges 109 times first, he says.
items.summary: Zelensky calls Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean Bridge a "fair response" — Russia hit Ukrainian bridges 109 times first, he says. Moscow's retaliation killed a 7-year-old boy and a paramedic in his hometown. (BBC, CNN)
body: Zelensky calls Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean Bridge a "fair response" — Russia hit Ukrainian bridges 109 times first, he says. Moscow's retaliation killed a 7-year-old boy and a paramedic in his hometown. (BBC, CNN)

Russia's "triple-tap" hit Kryvyi Rih on Friday night: ballistic missiles struck a restaurant area on Children's Day, then jet-powered drones targeted rescuers arriving at the scene. 2 killed, about 60 injured, including 6 children. (CNN, AP)

Zelensky says the bridge is no civilian target — open video shows Russian tanks and artillery crossing it to supply occupied Crimea. He calls Moscow's follow-up strikes proof Putin wants escalation, not peace. (BBC)

The fallout widens: UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting was in Kyiv backing Ukraine, London and Kyiv will build long-range drones together, and NATO's council meets Monday after Russian missiles fell in Poland. (BBC, AFP)

items.title: Iran strikes US bases in Bahrain; Gulf escalation widens
items.summary: 🚨 Iran struck Bahrain overnight, hitting a civilian industrial facility and starting a fire, Bahrain says. Tehran's Guards claim they targeted US bases hosting the Fifth Fleet. No injuries reported. (Reuters, Al Jazeera)
body: 🚨 Iran struck Bahrain overnight, hitting a civilian industrial facility and starting a fire, Bahrain says. Tehran's Guards claim they targeted US bases hosting the Fifth Fleet. No injuries reported. (Reuters, Al Jazeera)

The IRGC says missiles and drones hit US positions at al-Riffa and Awali bases, in retaliation for alleged US drone incursions into Iranian airspace. Bahrain says its air defences intercepted a number of the attacks. (Reuters)
The strike caps a widening Gulf escalation: Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh were intercepted on Saturday, and two tankers were hit near the Strait of Hormuz on Friday, per Saudi officials and ISW.
It is the latest in a string of Iranian strikes on Bahrain since Nov 13. Washington has said it will not escalate unless provoked — a line now being tested. (Reuters)
items.source: Reuters ("Bahrain says Iranian attack hits industrial facility as air defences intercept attacks"), Al Jazeera ("Bahrain says Iranian attack causes fire at industrial facility"), ISW/CTP (Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia Nov 20–21; Iran likely hit two tankers near Khasab, Oman)

items.title: Russian cargo ship Sparta II hit by drones in Baltic Sea
items.summary: 🚨 Russian cargo ship Sparta II was hit by two drones in the Baltic Sea and caught fire, drifting into Finnish waters. Finland warns the war is “spilling over.” (Reuters, CNN)
body: 🚨 Russian cargo ship Sparta II was hit by two drones in the Baltic Sea and caught fire, drifting into Finnish waters. Finland warns the war is “spilling over.” (Reuters, CNN)
The ship was bound for Kaliningrad when the drones struck in the Gulf of Finland, about 3 nautical miles from Russia's coast. All 16 crew evacuated safely to lifeboats. (Reuters)

Finland says Ukraine is likely behind the strike, its armed forces spokesman said — though it is not clear why the vessel was targeted. The ship is linked to Russian military logistics firm Oboronlogistika. (CNN)
Finland has imposed temporary air and sea restrictions in the eastern Gulf and is leading the rescue. PM Orpo: “The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas.” (CNN, Reuters)
items.source: Reuters ("Russia says cargo vessel struck by drones, Finland says it is on fire in its waters"), CNN ("Finland warns Ukraine war 'spilling over' after Baltic Sea drone strike on Russian cargo ship")
